title: Astramentis: All-Attribute Unique Amulet, Roll Scaling and Build Use in 0.5
summary: Astramentis is a Unique Stellar Amulet in Path of Exile 2 0.5.4 that grants +(50-100) to all Attributes and -4 Physical Damage taken. It is the premier levelling amulet and a core piece for attribute-stacking builds. This guide covers current rolls, the legacy 80-100 range, Divine reroll behaviour, attribute-scaling synergy with Hand of Wisdom and Action and Pillar of the Caged God, where it drops, valuation, and community questions.
description: How Astramentis works in Path of Exile 2 0.5.4: the +(50-100) all-attributes unique amulet, roll tiers, the legacy pre-0.2.0 range, Divine reroll rules, attribute-stacking synergy (HOWA / Pillar), drop sources, and trade valuation.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Astramentis is a Unique Stellar Amulet that grants +(50-100) to all Attributes and -4 Physical Damage taken. In 0.5.4 it is the strongest all-in-one levelling amulet and a core piece for attribute-stacking builds (for example the Gemling Legionnaire). Current rolls range 50-100; pre-0.2.0 copies rolled 80-100 and cannot be pushed into a higher bracket, only rerolled within their own range.
calloutDetail: Equip at level 24; the all-attribute bonus satisfies attribute requirements for gems and gear well above your level.
A Divine Orb rerolls the explicit +(50-100) line within the current range only; a legacy 80-100 copy stays in its own range.

answers.label: Use for
text: Meeting gem and gear attribute requirements while levelling, and feeding attribute-scaling uniques such as Hand of Wisdom and Action and Pillar of the Caged God in endgame stacker builds.

answers.label: Check first
text: Confirm the roll range - current 50-100 versus legacy 80-100 - before overpaying on trade.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Assuming a legacy high roll is strictly better: both current and legacy cap at 100, and a legacy copy cannot be improved with a Divine Orb.

sections.title: Roll tiers and the worked attribute total
sections.caption: How the implicit (5-7) and explicit (50-100) all-attribute lines combine into the total all-attribute bonus on a single roll.
sections.note: Worked example: a perfect roll grants 107 to Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence each (214 points above the implicit-only base). At 107 Intelligence, Hand of Wisdom and Action reaches 5 full 20-Intelligence thresholds (floor(107/20) = 5), adding its per-threshold Lightning Damage to Attacks; at 107 Dexterity it reaches 5 full 20-Dexterity thresholds for Attack Speed. Pillar of the Caged God scales its per-attribute bonuses off the same 107 per stat.

sections.title: Overview and current versus legacy
paragraphs: Astramentis is the signature all-attribute Unique amulet of Path of Exile 2. Its explicit +(50-100) to all Attributes dwarfs the implicit +(5-7) from the Stellar Amulet base, letting a single item meet the Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence gates of high-level gems and gear far earlier than normal. The -4 Physical Damage taken line adds flat mitigation that is welcome on a squishy levelling character.

Because every attribute scales gem requirements, resistances from gear, and life or evasion breakpoints, Astramentis is a strong option whenever a build is attribute-starved - which is most league starters and many stacker archetypes.

Current versus legacy: since Patch 0.2.0 the explicit line rolls +(50-100) to all Attributes. Copies that dropped before 0.2.0 rolled +(80-100) instead. A Divine Orb rerolls a line within its own generation range, so a current item stays 50-100 and a legacy item stays 80-100 - you cannot Divine a legacy copy up to a 'new' high roll, and you cannot push a current low roll past 100. On trade, identify the range from the listed roll before paying a premium.
bullets: Current (0.5.4): explicit +(50-100) all Attributes; implicit +(5-7); total 55-107.
Divine Orb rerolls only within the item's own generation range.
Both caps sit at 100, so the practical ceiling is identical; the difference is how often a low roll hurts.

sections.title: Build usage
intro: Astramentis supports any build that values raw attributes. The four personas below show where it pulls the most weight, from campaign levelling to attribute-stacking endgame.

Worked synergy: a perfect 107 all-attribute roll gives Hand of Wisdom and Action 5 full 20-attribute thresholds in both Intelligence (Lightning Damage to Attacks) and Dexterity (Attack Speed), and gives Pillar of the Caged God its full per-attribute scaling budget.

builds.title: Pure attribute stacker
builds.description: Runs Astramentis as the attribute engine, then scales uniques that convert attributes into damage or defence. A high roll is preferred.

builds.title: Requirement solver
builds.description: Uses the all-attribute line to equip high-requirement uniques (HOWA, Pillar of the Caged God) without heavy gear investment.

builds.title: Campaign twink
builds.description: A level-24 character equips Astramentis to leapfrog gem and gear attribute gates through Acts 2-3.

builds.title: Endgame bridge
builds.description: Holds the slot until a tailormade rare amulet with the right resists and life is farmed.

sections.title: Alternatives
paragraphs: Astramentis is not the only way to solve attributes. A Rare Stellar Amulet can roll flat attributes plus useful suffixes (resists, life, spirit), at the cost of the large unified all-attribute line and the -4 Physical mod.

Other Unique amulets trade the all-attribute line for specialised payoffs (e.g. conversion, cast speed, or defences) and suit narrower builds. They are worth considering only when your attributes are already covered by gear or passive points.

Catalysts improve the quality of the attribute line (more value per roll) but do not change the range; a Vaal Orb can corrupt the item for an extra implicit but risks losing the item, so it is a late-game gamble rather than a fix for a low roll.
bullets: Rare Stellar Amulet: flexible suffixes, smaller attribute total.
Other Unique amulets: build-specific, weaker for raw attributes.
Catalysts: quality the existing line; Vaal Orb: optional late-game corruption.

sections.title: How to get Astramentis
intro: Astramentis is a random Unique drop. It can drop from any enemy or boss at item level 24 or higher, so it appears from the campaign onward and throughout the endgame. There is no dedicated boss that exclusively drops it.

routes.label: Campaign and early maps (level 24+)
body: Farm any zone or boss at item level 24 and above. Higher item-level areas increase the chance of a well-rolled Unique.

routes.label: Boss repeats
body: Repeating campaign and early endgame bosses is a reliable way to fish for Uniques, including Astramentis.

routes.label: Trade (Currency Exchange / trade site)
body: Because it is trade-only, the fastest route is often to buy a specific roll from other players rather than farm for it.

routes.label: Catalysts and quality
body: Once obtained, use Catalysts to raise the quality of the attribute line; this is covered in the alternatives section.

sections.title: Valuation: use, sell, or hold
marketNote: Prices below reflect the Early Access 0.5.4 league on the PC trade site as of early August 2026 and move constantly with supply and demand.
Value scales with the explicit all-attribute roll: low rolls are cheap, high (near +100) rolls carry a clear premium.

use.condition: You are levelling or running an attribute-starved / stacker build
use.first: Equip the highest roll you can afford for the attribute budget
text: For most players a single Astramentis dramatically smooths progression and enables high-requirement uniques.

sell.condition: You already covered attributes elsewhere and do not scale off them
sell.first: List low and mid rolls on the trade site; price high rolls at a premium
sell.risk: Liquid but value drops if a new attribute Unique appears
text: It is a trade-only Unique with steady demand, so surplus copies are easy to liquidate.

hold.condition: You found a high (near +100) roll and may build a stacker later
hold.first: Keep it; catalyst it to push quality while held
text: A top-end roll retains value across leagues and is a strong socket for attribute builds.

entries.question: Is the old 80-100 Astramentis better than a new 50-100 one after the 0.2.0 change?
summary: A player wondered whether pre-0.2.0 copies are strictly stronger than current drops.
editorialAnalysis: Both generations cap at +100 all Attributes, so a perfect legacy roll equals a perfect current roll. The legacy floor (80) is higher than the current floor (50), meaning a random legacy is less likely to be a low roll - but a Divine cannot move either past 100.
officialAnswer: No generation beats the other at the top end; choose by the actual roll, not by legacy status.

entries.question: Can a Divine Orb push my Astramentis above +100?
summary: A player asked whether Divine Orbs can exceed the stated maximum.
editorialAnalysis: Divine Orbs reroll a line only within its own generation range. A current Astramentis rerolls 50-100; a legacy one rerolls 80-100. Neither can exceed 100.
officialAnswer: No - the explicit line is capped at +100 and stays within its own range when Divined.

entries.question: What is the best way to farm Astramentis in 0.5?
summary: A guide summarised drop and trade routes for the amulet.
editorialAnalysis: Astramentis is a generic Unique drop at item level 24+, so the fastest deterministic route is usually trade; farming relies on repeating bosses and maps.
officialAnswer: Farm level-24+ content for a random drop, or buy a specific roll on the trade site.

entries.question: Does Astramentis work for a Gemling Legionnaire stacker?
summary: A video showcased the amulet in an attribute-stacking build.
editorialAnalysis: Yes - the all-attribute line directly feeds attribute-scaling uniques such as Hand of Wisdom and Action, which the stacker archetype uses.
officialAnswer: It is a core enabler for attribute-stacking Gemling builds; pair it with a high roll and catalysts.

problems.symptom: My Astramentis shows only +50 to all Attributes
directAnswer: That is a low current roll (50-100 range). A Divine Orb can reroll it within 50-100, but it cannot exceed 100.
checks: Check the listed roll, then decide between Divining, buying a higher roll, or keeping it for levelling.

problems.symptom: Trade seller claims a 'legacy' copy is better
directAnswer: Legacy caps at +100 just like current; only the floor differs (80 vs 50). Compare the actual roll, not the label.
checks: Verify the explicit value; do not pay a legacy premium unless the roll is genuinely high.

directAnswer: Astramentis requires level 24. Reach level 24 before equipping.
checks: Check your character level against the Required Level of 24.

problems.symptom: Attributes still feel short for my gems
directAnswer: Astramentis covers a large flat budget, but high-requirement endgame gems may need more; supplement with passive points or a requirement-solving rare.
checks: Review gem requirements and passive allocation before swapping the amulet.
